answer: Because the willow solution is checked at the ocean gate and logged, the cedar audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 25 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. A farm of 214 pays that 53 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
